target_customer: Owners and operators of wind, solar and battery storage assets that sell into wholesale electricity markets.
problem: Renewable and storage operators face volatile wholesale power prices and need better price forecasts to schedule dispatch and reduce revenue risk.
business_model: B2B SaaS forecasting subscriptions plus a proprietary quant fund trading electricity

founders.name: Lauren Kuntz
education: PhD (field and school not stated in the release)
founders.background_notes: PR Newswire release names her as PhD.

technical_complexity.rationale: Price forecasting for power markets needs weather and grid modeling plus live trading infrastructure; the CEO holds a PhD.

defensibility.rationale: Forecast accuracy was the claimed edge, validated by trading, but customers could switch to established analytics vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The YC page shows the company was acquired; the buyer and date were not found in public sources.

market_need_then: Growing renewable and storage build-out increased price volatility, creating demand for forecasts; the company says its fund returns exceeded 30% in ERCOT in 2021 (company claim).

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission language about the grid of the future (Climatebase listing)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself and the name is easily confused with many other Gaia names.

outcome_analysis: Gaiascope joined YC in Summer 2019 selling grid forecasting to renewable and storage operators while running its own electricity trading fund. A $2M round labeled Seed Prime was announced in August 2021 with VoLo Earth Ventures leading, and the YC page lists it as acquired. The acquirer, date and price are not public, so whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing cannot be determined.
notes: Website gaia-scope.com returned HTTP 503 on fetch. The PR Newswire release labels the round Seed Prime, so the stage is recorded as other. Aggregators list additional seed rounds (about $2.3M, with ACE Investment Partners and others) and totals of $2.0M to $2.15M; unverified and not recorded as rounds. No 2019 dated competitor source was found, so the list is empty. Acquirer not found after two searches.
